text: Following the March 31, 2026 North York Community Council meeting, further information which is relevant to the appeal has been brought to my attention. The applicant was also unable to present his case due to technical issues.

North York Community Council: 1. Re-opened Item NY31.9 titled 71 Paperbirch Drive - Application to Remove a Private Tree amended by North York Community Council on March 31, 2026. 2. Deferred the consideration of Item NY31.9 until the North York Community Council meeting on May 26, 2026, and directed that Notice be issued in accordance with Municipal Code Chapter 813, Trees.
